data.long_meaning: The name Jenness is derived from the Old English name Jenny, which means 'Lord's favored one' or 'Jenny + grace'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jenness usually hope their child will grow to embody jenny + grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
